description: This file defines memory management functions and related constants for the Starboard platform, including allocation, deallocation, reallocation, memory mapping, and protection. It also includes documentation and deprecation notes for internal functions.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of at least the specified size.

methods.name: SbMemoryReallocate
methods.description: Resizes a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateAligned
methods.description: Allocates memory aligned to a specified boundary.

methods.name: SbMemoryDeallocate
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: SbMemoryMap
methods.description: Maps physical memory pages into virtual address space.

methods.name: SbMemoryFlush
methods.description: Flushes CPU caches for executable memory regions.

methods.name: SbMemoryGetStackBounds
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's stack bounds.
